videos.caption: Garlic Parmesan chicken pasta ✨ Ingredients  Chicken  - 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut in half - 1 tsp roasted garlic powder  - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp oregano  - 1 tsp Italian seasoning  - 1 tsp garlic and herb seasoning  - Salt to taste - 1 tbsp avocado oil (for cooking) - 1 tbsp unsalted butter (for cooking) Sauce + pasta - 14 oz fettuccine pasta  - 1 1/2 cup heavy cream - 6 tbsp unsalted butter - 1/4 cup pasta water - 7 garlic cloves (minced) - 1 shallot (minced) - 1 1/4 cups Parmesan cheese (grated)  - 1 tbsp freshly chopped parsley  - 1 1/2 tsp oregano  - 1 1/2 tsp roasted garlic powder - 1 tsp red chili flakes - Salt and pepper to taste  Instructions  - In a large bowl coat chicken breast with about 2 tsp of olive oil, seasonings, salt and mix until evenly coated. Cover and set aside for 30 minutes to marinate. - Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add avocado oil and 1 tbsp of butter. - Sear chicken for 5 minutes per side until a golden crust forms. Deglaze pan with a little chicken broth, lower the heat, cover, and simmer until internal temperature reaches 155F. - Remove chicken from pan, cover in foil, and place into oven set warm. Pasta  - Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil. Salt it heavily. - Cook pasta according to package instructions until al dente. - Reserve at least 1/4 cup pasta water, then drain. Sauce - To the same pan (medium heat) add butter. - Sauté shallot for 1–2 minutes until soft. - Add minced garlic and cook until fragrant (about 30 seconds). - Season with oregano, garlic powder, chili flakes, salt, and black pepper. Mix until well combined and fragrant  -  Pour in heavy cream and mix  - Simmer gently for 3–5 minutes until slightly thickened. - Lower heat and stir in Parmesan  cheese and pasta water. Mix until well combined. Taste and adjust for seasonings. - Add cooked fettuccine and parsley, mixing until well coated. - Stir in an additional ¼ cup Parmesan until fully combined. - Finish with chopped parsley. - Add sliced chicken on top of pasta  - Finish with extra Parmesan, cracked pepper, or chili flakes if desired. • • • #recipes #pasta #dinnerideas #chickenrecipe #foodideas

This One Pan Chicken & Gravy is an easy and delicious 30 minute dinner!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts  Salt, pepper, garlic powder  3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour  2 cups chicken broth  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, oregano, and thyme  1 tsp each of paprika, onion powder, garlic powder  INSTRUCTIONS  Cut chicken breasts in half lengthwise to make them thinner. Season the chicken with some salt, pepper, and garlic powder (I don’t use exact measurements for this part).  In a skillet over medium high heat melt 3 tbsp of butter. Once the butter has melted add 3 tbsp of flour and stir continuously until well combined. Let cook for a few minutes while still stirring.  Add 2 cups of chicken broth and stir well. Season with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder. Stir well and when it starts bubbling add the chicken to the skillet.  Make sure the chicken is covered in the gravy, cover with a lid, and turn the heat down to medium low. Let this cook for 12-15 minutes or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of 165 degrees. My chicken was ready in 12 minutes, but they were pretty thin.  Shred the chicken and serve over mashed potatoes! Enjoy! Combine the seasoning mix in a small pot or bowl, then evenly sprinkle over both sides of each breast. 2️⃣Place a large pan over medium-high heat and stir in the butter and oil. Add the chicken and fry for a few minutes on each side, or until lightly charred on the outside and piping hot/white through the centre. Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

Sticky Chicken Tender, seasoned chicken coated in a sweet and savory sticky sauce, served over warm rice and finished with green onions and sesame seeds. Ingredients For the Chicken 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon each black pepper and paprika  2 tablespoons olive oil About ⅓ cup cornstarch Olive oil, for cooking For the Sticky Sauce ½ cup soy sauce ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon ketchup 1 teaspoon ginger paste ½ tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons butter For Serving Cooked white rice Sliced green onions Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Add the chicken to a large bowl and season with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Sprinkle about ⅓ cup cornstarch over the seasoned chicken and toss until each piece is lightly and evenly coated. This helps give the chicken that tender, velvety texture and creates a great coating for the sauce. 3. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar or honey, hoisin sauce, ketchup, ginger paste, minced garlic, and 1½ tablespoons cornstarch until smooth. Set aside. 4. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in 2 batches so you don't overcrowd the pan. Cook until golden brown on the outside and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. 5. Reduce the heat and add 2 tablespoons of butter to the same skillet, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the pan. 6. Pour the prepared sauce into the skillet. Cook over low heat, whisking frequently, until the sauce begins to bubble and thickens into a glossy, sticky consistency. 7. Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and toss until every piece is completely coated in the sticky sauce. 8. Spoon the sticky chicken over warm rice and finish with sliced green onion.  #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #quickrecipes #easydinner #dinnerrecipes

🧀 Crispy Parmesan Chicken with Garlic Potatoes & Green Beans 🍗🥔 This Crispy Parmesan Chicken with Garlic Potatoes & Green Beans is an easy sheet-pan dinner packed with bold flavor. Juicy oven-roasted chicken is coated in a crispy Parmesan crust, while buttery garlic potatoes and tender green beans roast alongside for a complete, satisfying family meal with minimal cleanup. Ingredients For the Chicken • 4 boneless, skinless chicken breasts • 2 tbsp olive oil • ¾ cup grated Parmesan cheese • ½ cup panko breadcrumbs • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp Italian seasoning • ½ tsp smoked paprika • ¾ tsp salt • ½ tsp black pepper For the Potatoes • 1½ lbs baby Yukon Gold potatoes, halved • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp melted butter • 1 tsp garlic powder • ½ tsp paprika • Salt and black pepper, to taste For the Green Beans • 12 oz fresh green beans, trimmed • 1 tbsp olive oil • 2 garlic cloves, minced • 1 tbsp melted butter • Salt and black pepper, to taste For Garnish • 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley • Lemon wedges Instructions 1. Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Lightly grease a large sheet pan or line it with parchment paper. 2. Toss the potatoes with olive oil, melted butter, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and pepper. Spread them evenly on one side of the pan and roast for 15 minutes. 3. In a shallow bowl, combine the Parmesan cheese, panko breadcrumbs, garlic powder, Italian seasoning, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper. 4. Brush both sides of the chicken breasts with olive oil, then press them firmly into the Parmesan mixture until well coated. 5. Remove the sheet pan from the oven and move the potatoes to one side. Arrange the coated chicken in the center. 6. Toss the green beans with olive oil, melted butter, minced garlic, salt, and pepper, then place them beside the chicken. 7. Bake for 20–25 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C) and the potatoes are fork-tender. 8. Switch the oven to broil and cook for 2–3 minutes until the Parmesan crust is extra crispy and golden. 9. Sprinkle with fresh parsley and serve with lemon wedges. Serving Suggestions Serve with Caesar salad, garlic bread, roasted carrots, steamed broccoli, or creamy ranch dipping sauce for a complete restaurant-style dinner. Storage Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 4 days. Reheat in the oven or air fryer to keep the chicken crispy. Prep Time: 15 minutes Cook Time: 40 minutes Total Time: 55 minutes Servings: 4 Calories: Approximately 610 per serving #ParmesanChicken #SheetPanDinner #EasyDinner #ComfortFood #FamilyMeals

Perfect for a quick dinner that feels like a restaurant meal at home — your family will be asking for seconds before you even sit down! 🧀 You’ll Need: 	•	8–10 small flour tortillas 	•	3 cups cooked chicken, shredded (rotisserie chicken works great!) 	•	3 cups Monterey Jack cheese, divided 	•	2 tbsp butter 	•	2 tbsp flour 	•	2 cups chicken broth 	•	1 cup sour cream 	•	1 (4 oz) can diced green chiles 	•	Salt & pepper to taste 	•	Fresh chopped cilantro for garnish 🔥 How to Make It: 	1.	Preheat oven to 375°F and lightly grease a 9x13 baking dish. 	2.	Mix shredded chicken with 1 cup of Monterey Jack cheese. Fill each tortilla with a scoop of the mixture, roll them up, and place seam-side down in the dish. 	3.	Make the sauce: In a saucepan, melt butter over medium heat. Whisk in flour and cook 1 minute. Slowly add chicken broth, whisking until smooth and slightly thickened. 	4.	Remove from heat and stir in sour cream and green chiles. Season with salt and pepper. Don’t let it boil, or the sour cream might curdle! 	5.	Pour sauce evenly over enchiladas and top with remaining cheese. 	6.	Bake uncovered for 20–25 minutes, until bubbly and golden on top. 	7.	Garnish with fresh cilantro or a drizzle of extra sour cream before serving. 👩‍🍳 Amy’s Tip: Add a handful of spinach or diced jalapeños to the filling for a fun twist. These also freeze beautifully — double the batch and thank yourself later! This dish is the definition of creamy, cheesy comfort. CREAMY DAIRY-FREE MARRY ME CHICKEN✨ This easy, saucy, one-skillet chicken recipe is one to add to your "favorite weeknight dinners" list! It's cozy and simple and perfect for this time of year.  Ingredients:  1 1/2 lbs chicken breasts or thighs  2 tbsp avocado oil 3 cloves garlic, minced  1 can full fat coconut milk  1/2 cup chicken broth  1 tsp dried oregano 1 tbsp nutritional yeast 1/2 tsp crushed red pepper flakes  3/4 cup sun-dried tomatoes, roughly chopped  salt and pepper to season 1 tbsp arrowroot starch + a few tbsp of chicken broth  1/2 cup fresh basil, julienned + more for garnishing Directions:  Season the chicken on both sides with salt and pepper  Heat avocado oil in a large skillet over medium high heat  Sear the chicken on both sides for 3-4 minutes per side (being careful not to move them while they sear) then remove from pan and set aside  Turn the heat to medium-low and add a drizzle more avocado oil  Add the garlic to the oil (I like to keep the garlic together here and stir it often to keep it from burning) and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant  Add the coconut milk, stirring to deglaze the pan of any bits that have hardened  Add the chicken broth, sun-dried tomatoes, nutritional yeast, oregano, and crushed red pepper and stir Bring to a simmer and add the chicken back to the pan Cover and cook for 15 minutes at a simmer  Make a slurry mixture by whisking the arrowroot starch with a few tbsp of chicken broth until not lumps remain Once the chicken has finished cooking, move the chicken to the perimeter of the dish and whisk in the slurry mixture  Remove from heat and stir in the basil  Serve with more basil to garnish and ENJOY! Creamy, Cheesy & Loaded with Flavor – This One-Pan Chicken Tortellini is a MUST-TRY! 🍗🥘 Creamy One-Pan Chicken Tortellini Delight Ingredients: For the Chicken: 1 ½ lb boneless, skinless chicken breasts or thighs – Cut into bite-sized pieces 1 tsp smoked paprika – Adds a deep, smoky richness 1 tsp garlic powder – Enhances the savory flavor 1 tsp Italian seasoning – Classic herb blend for depth Salt & black pepper, to taste – Elevates the flavors 1 tbsp olive oil – For perfectly golden seared chicken For the Sauce & Pasta: 1 tbsp olive oil – For extra richness ½ large white onion, finely diced – Adds sweet, aromatic depth 3 cloves garlic, minced – Bold, garlicky goodness ½ cup sun-dried tomatoes, chopped – Tangy, slightly sweet bite 2 cups marinara sauce – Your favorite for a bold, rich base 1 ½ cups chicken broth – Adds a velvety depth 1 lb fresh cheese tortellini – Soft, cheesy pasta perfection 1 cup heavy cream – For a luxuriously creamy sauce ½ tsp smoked paprika – Extra warmth & earthiness 1 tsp Italian seasoning – Infuses classic Mediterranean flavors ¼ tsp crushed red pepper flakes (optional) – Adds a little kick ½ tsp salt & ¼ tsp black pepper – To balance the flavors ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese – Ultimate cheesy indulgence 2 cups baby spinach – A fresh, nutritious touch For Garnish: Fresh basil or parsley – Bright, herbaceous finish Extra Parmesan – Because more cheese is always a good idea! Instructions: 1. Sauté the Chicken: • Season chicken with salt, pepper, garlic powder, smoked paprika, and Italian seasoning. • Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large, deep skillet over medium-high heat. • Sear chicken until golden brown & cooked through (about 5-6 minutes per side). • Remove from skillet and set aside. 2. Cook the Aromatics: • In the same skillet, add 1 tbsp olive oil. • Sauté diced onions until soft (about 3 minutes). • Stir in garlic & sun-dried tomatoes, cooking for 1 minute. 3.
